focus: Data visualization, statistics, statistical analysis, and reproducible scientific computing
title: From Financial History to Forecasts: Making Uncertainty Visible
utility_title: CSV Statistics and Reproducible Bootstrap Mean Interval
utility_use_case: A research analyst receives a CSV export of repeated measurements and wants a quick, auditable check of the numeric values before building a visualization or inferential model. They run the utility with a recorded seed, inspect the missing and invalid counts, then use the JSON summary as a reproducible checkpoint in their analysis notes. The bootstrap interval offers a descriptive view of resampling variability in the sample mean, not a claim about future observations or a significance result.
